description: Return a generated item itself, for showing it where a YouSpot link cannot be opened: a social image comes back as the PNG, a PDF as an image of each page, an email, document or Substack post as its text. Takes an artifact_id from a generator or list_artifacts. A draft comes back watermarked; the user unlocks the clean copy for a credit.

artifact_id.description: An artifact_id from a generator or list_artifacts.

name: read_artifact
title: Show generated item
